'''Get The Flying Machine!!''' (Japanese: '''空飛ぶマシーンを手に入れろ！！''' ''Obtain the Flying Machine!!'') is the sixteenth chapter of the [[Pokémon Pocket Monsters]] manga. It was first published in the July 1997 issue of CoroCoro Comic, on June 15th, 1997.

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}

==Major events==
* {{PPM|Red}} tries to buy a flying machine at a convenience store before {{PPM|Blue}} does.
